The build process follows standard practices for Nginx modules: it creates symbolic links to the nginx-mainline source files (installed via nginx-mainline-src), configures the module with --with-compat and --add-dynamic-module, then compiles it using `make modules`. No suspicious commands (e.g., `curl|bash`, `wget`, `eval`, obfuscated payloads) are present. All operations are confined to the build environment and consistent with packaging a dynamic Nginx module. The use of `ln -sf` to link to system-installed Nginx source files is normal and expected in this context.
